x: بِسْمِ اللَّـهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ. الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ العَالَمِينَ، حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الوَكِيلُ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا باللَّهِ العَلِيِّ العَظِيمِ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَبْرَأُ مِنْ حَوْلِي وَقُوَّتِي إِلَى حَوْلِكَ وَقُوَّتِكَ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَتَقَرَّبُ إِلَيْكَ بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ، عَبْدِكَ وَنَبِيِّكَ وَرَسُولِكَ سَيِّدِ المُرْسَلِينَ، صَلَّى اللَّهُ تَعَالَى وَسَلَّمَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَيْهِمْ أَجْمَعِينَ، امْتِثَالًا لِأَمْرِكَ وَتَصْدِيقًا لَهُ وَمَحَبَّةً فِيهِ وَشَوْقًا إِلَيْهِ وَتَعْظِيمًا لِقَدْرِهِ، وَلِكَوْنِهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَهْلًا لِذَلِكَ، فَتَقَبَّلْهَا مِنِّي بِفَضْلِكَ، وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنْ عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ، وَوَفِّقْنِي لِقِرَاءَتِهَا عَلَى الدَّوَامِ بِجَاهِهِ عِنْدَكَ، وَصَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ أَجْمَعِينَ.

Alḥamdu liLlāhi rabbil ʿālamīn, ḥasbiyAllāhu wa niʿmal wakīl wa lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā biLlahil ʿaliyyi alʿaẓim. Allāhumma inni abraʾu min ḥawlī wa quwwatī ilā ḥawlika wa quwwatika. Allāhumma innī ataqarrabu ilayka biṣṣalāti ʿala sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿabdika wa nabiyyika wa rasūlika sayyidil mursalīna ṣallAllāhu taʿālā wasallama ʿalayhi waʿalayhim ajmaʿīna imtithālan li amrika wa taṣdīqan lahu wa maḥabbatan fīhi washawqan ilayhi wataʿẓīman liqadrihi walikawnihi ṣallAllahu ʿalayhi wasallama ahlan lidhalika fataqabbalhā minnī bifaḍlika wajʿalnī min ʿibadikaṣ ṣāliḥīna wawaffiqnī liqirāʾatihā ʿalād dawāmi bijāhihi ʿindaka waṣallAllāhu ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ālihi waṣaḥbihi ajmaʿīn.

In the Name of Allah. All praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds. He suffices me, 'and how excellent a Trustee is He!' And there is no power or strength but through Allah, the Sublime, the Almighty. O Allah, I disown any power and strength of mine in favour of Your power and strength. O Allah, I seek nearness to You by exaltation of our Master Muhammad, Your Slave, Prophet and Emissary, the Chief of the Emissaries, may Allah Most High exalt and preserve him and all of them. I do so in obedience to Your command, with conviction in him, with love and yearning for him, and with veneration for his status and for the fact that he, may Allah exalt and preserve him, is worthy of that. Accept it from me by Your grace, and make me one of Your righteous slaves. By virtue of his rank in Your sight, grant me success in reciting it [Dalā'il al- Khayrāt] continually. May Allah exalt our Master Muhammad and his Family and Companions one and all.
أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ العَظِيمَ (3)
AstaghfiruLlāha alʿaẓīm (3).
I ask Allah's forgiveness (x3).
سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا باللَّهِ العَلِيِّ العَظِيم (3)
SubḥānAllāhi, walḥamduliLlāhi, wa lā ilaha illAllāhu, wAllāhu akbaru, wa lā hawla wa lā quwwata illa biLlahil ʿaliyyil ʿaẓīm (3).
Glory be to Allah, Praise be to Allah. There is no God but Allah. Allah is Greatest. There is no power or strength except by Allah the Lofty, the Tremendous. (x3)
حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الوَكِيلُ (3)
ḤasbiyAllāhu wa niʿmal wakīl (3).
Allah suffices me, and how excellent a Guardian Trustee is He! (x3)

أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ. بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ. ﴿ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ . اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ . لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ . وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ ﴾ (3)
Aʿūdhu biLlāhi minash shayṭānir rajīm. BismiLlāhir raḥmānir raḥīm. Qul huwaLlāhu aḥad. Allāhuṣ ṣamad. Lam yalid walam yūlad. Walam yakullahu kufuwan aḥad. (3)

I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Satan. In the Name of Allah, The All-Merciful, the Most Merciful. Say: 'He is Allah, the One and Only; Allah, the Eternal, Absolute; He does not beget, nor was He begotten; And there is none that compares with Him.' (x3)

بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ﴿ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ . مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ . وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ . وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّـٰثَـٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ . وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ ﴾ بِسْمِ اللَّـهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ﴿ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ . مَلِكِ النَّاسِ . إِلَـٰهِ النَّاسِ . مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ . الَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ النَّاسِ . مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ ﴾

BismiLlāhir raḥmānir raḥīm. Qul aʿūdhu birabbil falaq. Min sharri mā khalaq. Wa min sharri ghāsiqin idha waqab. Wa min sharrin naffāthāti fīl ʿuqad. Wamin sharri ḥāsidin idhā ḥasad. BismiLlāhir raḥmānir raḥīm. Qul aʿūdhu birabbin nās. Malikin nās. Ilāhin nās. Min sharril waswāsil khannās. Alladhī yuwaswisu fī ṣudurin nās. Minal jinnati wannās.

In the Name of Allah, The All-Merciful, the Most Merciful. Say: 'I seek refuge in the Lord of the Daybreak; From the evil of that which He has created; From the evil of darkness when it overspreads; From the evil of women blowing upon knots; And from an envier's evil when he envies.' In the Name of Allah, The All-Merciful, the Most Merciful. Say: 'I seek refuge with the Lord and Cherisher of Mankind; The King of Mankind; The God of Mankind; From the evil of the sneaking whisperer; Who whispers into the hearts of people; Of the jinns and of mankind.'

﴿ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ . الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَـٰلَمِينَ . الرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ . مَـٰلِكِ يَوْمِ الدِّينِ . إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ . اهْدِنَا الصِّرَٰطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ . صِرَٰطَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّآلِّينَ ﴾

BismiLlāhir raḥmānir raḥīm. Alḥamdu liLlāhi rabbil ʿālamīn. Arraḥmānir raḥīm. Māliki yawmid dīn. Iyyāka naʿbudu wa iyyāka nastaʿīn. Ihdināṣ ṣirāṭal mustaqīm. Ṣirāṭal ladhīna anʿamta ʿalayhim ghayril maghḍūbi ʿalayhim walāḍ ḍāllīn.

In the Name of Allah, The All-Merciful, the Most Merciful. Praise be to Allah, Lord and Sustainer of the worlds; The All-Merciful, The Most Merciful; Master of the Day of Judgment. You [alone] do we worship, and You [alone] we ask for help. Guide us upon the straight way: The way of those whom You have blessed; Not those who have angered You, or those who are astray.

بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ﴿ الٓمٓ . ذَٰلِكَ الْكِتَـٰبُ لَا رَيْبَ ۛ فِيهِ ۛ هُدًى لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ . الَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْغَيْبِ وَيُقِيمُونَ الصَّلَوٰةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَـٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ . وَالَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ مِن قَبْلِكَ وَبِالْآخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ . أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدًى مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ ۖ وَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ ﴾

BismiLlāhir raḥmānir raḥīm. Alif Lām Mīm. Dhālikal kitābu lā raybai fīh hudan lilmuttaqīn. Alladhīna yuʾminūna bilghaybi wayuqīmūnaṣ ṣalāta wamimmā razaqnāhum yunfiqūn. Walladhīna yuʾminūna bimā ʾunzila ilayka wamā ʾunzila min qablika wa bilākhirati hum yūqinūn. Ūlāʾika ʿalā hudam mir rabbihim wa ūlāʾika humul mufliḥūn.

In the Name of Allah, The All-Merciful, the Most Merciful. Alif. Lām. Mīm. This is the Book in which there is no doubt; Sure guidance for the godly; Who believe in the Unseen, establish prayer, and spend of what We have provided for them; And who believe in that which is revealed to You and that which was revealed before you, and who are certain of the Hereafter. Those are following sure guidance from their Lord, and it is those who shall prosper.
Duʿāʾ al-Iftitāḥ — 8.
